note: LEGACY — retired flat data vault. The service-preset TTL cache moved to the cache floor (active/shared/cache/<tier>/<tenant|shared>/service-preset/, storage/service-preset-cache.ts); nothing writes here any more. Leftover entries on existing deployments are deleted 30 days after their last write (the cache partitions' TTL), audited, by the janitor's scanLegacyDataVault sweep; until then tenant offboarding still claims a tenant's admitted entries (collectLegacyDataVaultTargets). Remove this entry together with that sweep, that offboarding claim and the run_pipeline / run_super_pipeline active/shared/data-vault/ grants once deployments no longer hold the directory.
